title: Light-dependent flavin redox and adduct states control the conformation and DNA-binding activity of the transcription factor EL222.
authors: Chaudhari, Aditya S; Favier, Adrien; Tehrani, Zahra Aliakbar; Koval, Tomas; Andersson, Inger; Schneider, Bohdan; Dohnalek, Jan; Cerny, Jiri; Brutscher, Bernhard; Fuertes, Gustavo
one_liner_zh: 该文通过X射线晶体学、NMR、MD/metadynamics模拟及非天然氨基酸工程，系统解析光敏转录因子EL222的FMN氧化还原/加合物状态如何调控其构象与DNA结合活性，核心聚焦TF-DNA互作机制且方法含物理模拟，高度匹配本课题。
abstract: The activity of the light-oxygen-voltage/helix-turn-helix (LOV-HTH) photoreceptor EL222 is regulated through protein-protein and protein-DNA interactions, both triggered by photo-excitation of its flavin mononucleotide (FMN) cofactor. To gain molecular-level insight into the photocycle of EL222, we applied complementary methods: macromolecular X-ray crystallography (MX), nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) spectroscopy, optical spectroscopies (infrared and UV-visible), molecular dynamics/metadynamics (MD/metaD) simulations, and protein engineering using noncanonical amino acids. Kinetic experiments provided evidence for two distinct EL222 conformations (lit1 and lit2) that become sequentially populated under illumination. These two lit states were assigned to covalently bound N5 protonated, and noncovalently bound hydroquinone forms of FMN, respectively. Only subtle structural differences were observed between the monomeric forms of all three EL222 species (dark, lit1, and lit2). While the dark state is largely monomeric, both lit states undergo monomer-dimer exchange. Furthermore, molecular modeling revealed differential dynamics and interdomain separation times arising from the three FMN states (oxidized, adduct, and reduced). Unexpectedly, all three EL222 species can associate with DNA, but only upon blue-light irradiation, a high population of stable complexes is obtained. Overall, we propose a model of EL222 activation where photoinduced changes in the FMN moiety shift the population equilibrium toward an open conformation that favors self-association and DNA-binding.
abstract_zh: 光-氧-电压/螺旋-转角-螺旋（LOV-HTH）光受体EL222的活性通过蛋白质-蛋白质和蛋白质-DNA相互作用调控，两者均由黄素单核苷酸（FMN）辅因子的光激发触发。为获得EL222光循环的分子层面见解，我们采用了互补方法：大分子X射线晶体学（MX）、核磁共振（NMR）波谱学、光学光谱学（红外和紫外-可见光）、分子动力学/元动力学（MD/metaD）模拟，以及使用非天然氨基酸的蛋白质工程。动力学实验提供了两种不同EL222构象（lit1和lit2）的证据，这些构象在光照下依次被占据。这两种光激发态分别被归属为共价结合的N5质子化FMN和非共价结合的对苯二酚形式FMN。在所有三种EL222物种（暗态、lit1和lit2）的单体形式之间仅观察到细微的结构差异。虽然暗态主要以单体存在，但两种光激发态均经历单体-二聚体交换。此外，分子建模揭示了由三种FMN状态（氧化态、加合物态和还原态）产生的差异动力学和结构域分离时间。出乎意料的是，所有三种EL222物种都能与DNA结合，但仅在蓝光照射下，才能获得高比例的稳定复合物。总体而言，我们提出了一个EL222激活模型，其中光诱导的FMN部分变化将群体平衡转向有利于自结合和DNA结合的开放构象。
